disclaimer: Automated checks against public rule texts; not legal advice. A human reviews every package before use.

character_limits.source: Google Ads responsive search ads (headlines 30, descriptions 90); 160 characters is one GSM-7 SMS segment.

rules.description: Ad copy must not state a preference or limitation based on familial status.
Ad copy must not reference race, color, religion or national origin as a preference or as a description of the people in an area.
Ad copy must not exclude or discourage people with disabilities.
Ad copy must not urge owners to sell because of who is moving into the neighborhood (blockbusting).
Every SMS discloses how to revoke consent with at least one standardized word (for example 'Reply STOP to opt out').
Every SMS identifies the sender by the brand name of the package.

The lead form shows a consent statement: the person agrees to receive automated marketing texts and calls at the number provided, consent is not a condition of any purchase, and they can reply STOP to opt out.
Texts are sent only between 8 a.m. and 9 p.m. in the recipient's local time. The package cannot schedule sends, so this always goes to human review.

human_review_patterns.description: Claims the code cannot verify: they are not rejected, they go to the human review list.

rules.reason: Promises a price, speed or fee condition that only the buyer of the lead can confirm.
Talks about insurance coverage or claims, which depend on each policy.
